subtitle.en: 610–750 · from a cave to an empire in five generations
subtitle.zh: 610–750 · 五代人之间，从山洞到帝国

summary.en: A merchant in a trading town hears a voice in 610. By 750 his followers rule from the Atlantic to the Indus, pray in a language that has become the lingua franca of half the known world, and have built, in Damascus and Jerusalem, the first monuments of a new civilisation. The speed is unmatched in history; the reasons are still argued.
summary.zh: 610年，一个商业城镇的商人听到一个声音。到750年，他的追随者统治着从大西洋到印度河的土地，用一种已成为半个已知世界通用语的语言祈祷，并在大马士革和耶路撒冷建起了一个新文明的第一批纪念碑。这个速度史无前例；原因至今仍在争论。

source: Ibn Ishaq, Sira; al-Tabari, History; H. Kennedy, The Great Arab Conquests (2007); F. Donner, Muhammad and the Believers (2010)

text.en: Muhammad, forty, a merchant of the Quraysh, retreats to a cave above Mecca and hears: 'Recite.' The revelations continue for 22 years; collected after his death, they are the Qur'an. Mecca's merchants, whose wealth rests on the pagan pilgrimage, are not pleased.
text.zh: 四十岁的古莱什商人穆罕默德隐居麦加城外的山洞，听到：「诵读。」启示持续二十二年；他死后结集，即《古兰经》。靠多神朝圣发财的麦加商人不高兴。

text.en: Invited to arbitrate the feuds of Yathrib, Muhammad and his followers leave Mecca. The hijra is year one of the Islamic calendar: the moment a preacher becomes the head of a community with its own law.
text.zh: 应邀调停叶斯里卜的部族争斗，穆罕默德和追随者离开麦加。希吉拉是伊斯兰历元年：一个传道者成为一个有自己法律的共同体之首的时刻。

text.en: Three hundred Muslims defeat a Meccan force three times their size. The victory is read as divine endorsement and makes Muhammad a military leader as well as a prophet.
text.zh: 三百名穆斯林击败三倍于己的麦加军。这场胜利被解读为神的认可，使穆罕默德在先知之外也成为军事领袖。

text.en: Muhammad enters Mecca almost without a fight, clears the Kaaba of its idols and pardons his enemies. Within two years the tribes of Arabia have submitted. He dies in Medina in 632, leaving no instructions about a successor.
text.zh: 穆罕默德几乎不费一兵一卒进入麦加，清除天房中的偶像，赦免敌人。两年内阿拉伯诸部归顺。632年他在麦地那去世，没有留下关于继承人的指示。

text.en: Khalid ibn al-Walid destroys the main Byzantine field army after a six-day battle. Heraclius, who had just won back the Holy Land from Persia, abandons Syria: 'Farewell, a long farewell.' Damascus, Jerusalem and Antioch follow within three years.
text.zh: 哈立德·本·瓦利德经六天激战全歼拜占庭主力野战军。刚从波斯手中夺回圣地的希拉克略放弃叙利亚：「别了，永别了。」大马士革、耶路撒冷、安条克三年内相继归附。

text.en: The Sasanian army is broken; Ctesiphon falls and its treasure — the great garden carpet of Khosrow — is cut into pieces and shared out. Within fifteen years the 400-year-old Persian empire is gone, and Persia will become Muslim while keeping its language.
text.zh: 萨珊军被击溃；泰西封陷落，库思老的巨幅「花园地毯」被切成碎块分掉。十五年内四百年的波斯帝国不复存在；波斯将皈依伊斯兰而保留自己的语言。

text.en: Amr ibn al-As takes Egypt, the richest province of the Byzantine empire, with 4,000 men, and founds a garrison town that will grow into Cairo. The Coptic Christians, persecuted by Constantinople, mostly do not resist.
text.zh: 阿慕尔·本·阿斯以四千人夺取拜占庭最富庶的行省埃及，建了一座日后长成开罗的军营城。受君士坦丁堡迫害的科普特基督徒大多没有抵抗。

text.en: Caliph Uthman orders a single authoritative text of the Qur'an compiled and copies sent to the garrison cities; variant versions are burned. Arabic now has a book, and the book fixes the language for fourteen centuries.
text.zh: 哈里发奥斯曼下令编定《古兰经》的唯一定本，抄本送往各军镇，异本焚毁。阿拉伯语从此有了一部书，这部书把这门语言固定了十四个世纪。

text.en: After a civil war over the succession, Mu'awiya makes himself caliph and moves the capital from Medina to Damascus. The Umayyads rule as kings; the community splits permanently between those who accept them and the party — shi'a — of Ali.
text.zh: 继承权内战之后，穆阿维叶自立为哈里发，把都城从麦地那迁到大马士革。倭马亚家族以国王的方式统治；共同体从此永久分裂为接受他们的人和阿里的党人——什叶派。

text.en: Husayn, grandson of the Prophet, and seventy companions are killed by an Umayyad army. His death becomes the founding martyrdom of Shi'a Islam, mourned every year at Ashura.
text.zh: 先知的外孙侯赛因和七十名同伴被倭马亚军队杀害。他的死成为什叶派伊斯兰的奠基性殉难，每年阿舒拉日悼念。

text.en: Abd al-Malik completes the Dome of the Rock on the Temple Mount: the first great building of Islam, its mosaics quoting the Qur'an against the Christian doctrine of the Trinity. He also makes Arabic the language of government and mints the first Islamic coins.
text.zh: 阿卜杜勒-马利克在圣殿山建成圆顶清真寺：伊斯兰的第一座伟大建筑，马赛克上的《古兰经》经文针对基督教三位一体论。他还把阿拉伯语定为行政语言，铸造第一批伊斯兰钱币。

text.en: Tariq ibn Ziyad lands with 7,000 Berbers; the rock takes his name, Jabal Tariq. The Visigothic kingdom collapses in a year. Al-Andalus will be Muslim, in whole or part, for 781 years.
text.zh: 塔里克·本·齐亚德率七千柏柏尔人登陆；那块岩石以他为名——「塔里克之山」。西哥特王国一年内崩溃。安达卢斯将在此后781年里全部或部分属于穆斯林。

text.en: The second Arab siege of the capital fails against the walls, Greek fire and a hard winter. Byzantium survives for another seven centuries and becomes the shield behind which Latin Europe forms.
text.zh: 阿拉伯人第二次围攻君士坦丁堡，败于城墙、希腊火和严冬。拜占庭又活了七个世纪，成为拉丁欧洲在其身后成形的盾牌。

text.en: Charles Martel's Franks stop a raiding army between Tours and Poitiers. Gibbon imagined the Qur'an taught at Oxford had it gone otherwise; most historians now think the raid was already at its limit. Either way, the Pyrenees become the frontier.
text.zh: 查理·马特的法兰克人在图尔与普瓦捷之间挡住一支劫掠军。吉本想象若非如此牛津会教《古兰经》；今天多数史家认为那次劫掠本已到极限。无论如何，比利牛斯山成了边界。

text.en: The Abbasids, descended from the Prophet's uncle, destroy the Umayyads at the Zab and massacre the family at a banquet. One prince escapes to Spain. The capital moves east to a new city on the Tigris: Baghdad. The age of conquest ends; the age of Arabic learning begins.
text.zh: 先知叔父的后裔阿拔斯家族在大扎卜河击溃倭马亚，在宴席上屠灭其族。一位王子逃到西班牙。都城东迁到底格里斯河畔的新城巴格达。征服的时代结束，阿拉伯学术的时代开始。

text.en: An Abbasid army defeats a Tang Chinese one in Central Asia. Among the prisoners are papermakers; within fifty years Baghdad has paper mills. The two empires never fight again, and Central Asia turns toward Islam.
text.zh: 阿拔斯军队在中亚击败唐军。俘虏中有造纸工匠；五十年内巴格达有了造纸坊。两个帝国再未交战，中亚转向伊斯兰。
